description: A stacked bar chart whose tooltip lists series names and values without color indicators.
overview: A stacked bar chart whose tooltip lists series names and values without any color marker. Use it for single-series charts, or when the series names are clear enough on their own.
usage: Set `hideIndicator` on `ChartTooltipContent`. Replace `chartData` and the series in `chartConfig`, and keep the labels descriptive since they are the only cue.
notes: With several series and no color marker, readers can't match a row to a bar by color, so this suits one or two clearly named series best.
